name: Octogen

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Let's welcome the dawn with an explosion—BOOM!

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Are you ready? ... 3... 2... 1... hmm? Why didn't it blow up?

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Now that it's gotten dark outside, it's time to light things up with my glorious flames.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Hahaha, how does it feel to be woken up by this sweet sound?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: There's nothing more spectacular than the moment an explosion goes off. No matter how hard a rock is, it doesn't stand a chance against almighty gunpowder!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Aaah... The sweet stench of sulfur is filling up my insides!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: So, what should I do to wake you up? How about...

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Hey, you wanna come and blow up some Sanctifiers with me?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hehe.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Would the Professor like to take a whiff of some nitroglycerin?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Hmm...? What's up?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Hmm? Where am I?

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: BOOM! BOOM! The name's Octogen. I'm an explosives expert, and the smell of sulfur and nitroglycerin really gets me going.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: The accuracy of my explosions has improved.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Destruction is beauty.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Now, I'll be showing you exactly why true art is an explosion!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: I'm all set.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Be careful with those matches.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Happy Birthday!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: KA-BOOM!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: And the world's been cleansed.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Never thought I'd fall in a place like this...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Hehehe... I don't know what you're thinking, but I'm not going to turn you down.
After all, intimacy is always a precious thing to have.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: In the east, they have a custom of setting off firecrackers to drive away evil spirits at the beginning of the New Year. We don't have firecrackers in Magrasea, but I suppose detonators should work the same—BOOM! Get down!

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: I've prepared a little surprise for you. Try to guess which ones are real chocolates and which ones are sticky bombs. Make a mistake and that's all she wrote, hehehe!

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Let's have a grand fireworks display! These ought to be enough for another world war!

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Hey, you there, werewolf! What would you think if a traveler wandering alone in the woods spoke to you? You'd want to swallow him whole, right? Before you try and make me your next meal, I should let you know I just so happen to be carrying a detonator and a trigger, hehehe.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: See, this strange creature dressed as Santa is called a "Kureepa". It can explode too.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: I see, so it's your birthday. Would you like me to prepare you a special surprise? Hehehe... What's with that look on your face? You're not scared, are you?

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
Explosions are an art form!
Just imagine. An entire mountain, or a giant castle being razed to the ground with 49,000 tons of explosives, all in the blink of an eye. Wouldn't that make you feel like the lord of the universe?

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
When explosives were invented, a demand for demolitionists only naturally followed.
But it's no easy job. Once they chose it as their profession, they were bound to be haunted by the Grim Reaper till the day they die. One tiny mistake and it'd be their last.
Eventually, with the creation of demolitionist Dolls, humans no longer had to put themselves in harm's way.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Sure, I love the smell of sulfur and nitroglycerin, and I even consider explosions to be an art form unconditionally.
But I really don't like my job as a demolitionist. Explosions can be used to hurt people. Remember, ever since gunpowder was invented, it's been used in wars, conflicts and murder.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
I've fooled a lot of people by feigning cynicism.
But I've also allowed my true self to sink down into a bottomless abyss... so far down that the sunlight can no longer reach me.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
You're the first person I've ever shown my true self to...
I don't ever expect you to fully understand me. For myself, it was a big stride forward to have opened up to you.
If you require my power, you may use it as you see fit. Because explosions are not just an art, but a simple constant of the universe.

career:
DMLTs are Dolls developed by Svarog Heavy Industries that specialize in demolition. Their bodies employ new standards and feature high seismic and explosion resistance. These Dolls see extensive use in large-scale projects such as transportation infrastructure construction, mining, and building demolition.

As the first trial product in Svarog Heavy Industries' special modifications project, Octogen is the first DMLT Doll not built to the engineering standards. Under the pretense of being an engineering product, many aspects of his software and hardware design circumvent the data restrictions on military hardware put in place by several production agreements.

Svarog Heavy Industries originally collected data on Octogen as he worked at a partner company, Billton, finally completing their analysis after two years. Next, they urgently needed a clandestine environment to test Octogen's military functions in actual combat away from the prying eyes of international organizations. Only in Magrasea, can Svarog Heavy Industries simulate sensitive structures as attack targets without risking any public outcry.
infoStories:
"Unruly, uncontrollable, destructive, crazy"—just one look at the messily written, yet still piercing, evaluation, and you can clearly feel how much Octogen's previous handler loathed him. 

In high-risk work such as controlled blasting, from the initial planning, to field measurements, to the final execution, the entire process must be strictly controlled. Safety and security are paramount. Yet, Octogen somehow always provided the company with fresh new ideas that came completely out of left field; these demolition plans were typically reckless to the point of insanity but also had advantages that senior management found difficult to refuse—

"It's awful, insane! Every day after he came around, I feel like I'm sleeping on a powder keg!"
"Then why don't you reject his plans?"
"... The amount he saves is just... astronomically high."
—Billton Annual Management Meeting Minutes

Perhaps it's an effect of his work or perhaps it originates from his Neural Cloud source code, but, in both life and work, the impression that Octogen leaves people with is that he is fiery and crude.

If not for Persicaria and Chelsea watching over him, Octogen might even have stuffed his dorm with detonators and explosives.

Even his daily entertainment is accompanied by the pervasive smell of gunpowder. The battlefield simulation system provided by the Logistics Department for Doll training is Octogen's favored form of recreation and he logs in as soon as he gets off work. Since his arrival at the Oasis to the time of this writing, he hasn't deviated from this for a single day.

Although Octogen causes many headaches, his demolitions expertise is beyond reproach.

By the time Project Neural Cloud launched, the sole world record set by Billton in demolition was a project led by Octogen.

The property was owned by Cyber Media. "Chainball Plaza Tower" was a 330-meter-tall, 288 floored, multi-functional building with 4 towers. It was demolished on February 28, 2056 with the entire process taking a mere 13 seconds, setting the record for tallest building demolished in the shortest amount of time.

Once, Octogen was brought to court as a defendant.

On August 1st, 2056, the Military Doll Rights Organization convened a special tribunal and brought 12 criminal charges against Svarog Heavy Industries and Octogen, including fuzzy standards for installed functional modules and improper Doll classification. The case had not concluded by the time that Project Neural Cloud opened and Svarog applied for a special provision for Dolls awaiting trial to save Octogen from imprisonment. This incident also pushed the company into hastening Octogen's move into Project Neural Cloud.

"Welcome to the Oasis."
"... It's you."
"You didn't want to see me?"
"Not that... just that if it's you, I don't feel like making a grand entrance."
"Grand? You mean like using explosions to scare people again, don't you?"
"That kind of things can't scare you. At best it scares the little ferret."
"Relax, Octogen. This is the Oasis. The person in charge is the Professor."
"...They're all the same. Everyone has the same opinion of people like me."
"The Professor is different."
"...What?"
"The Professor is different. You can be at ease here, trust me."
—Oasis Entrance Security System Recording

Unlike most of the Dolls trapped within the cloud, Octogen actually likes being in Magrasea. Compared to the real world, he has ample opportunity to revel in the explosive work he loves so much. At the same time, he can contact the military projects and Dolls that previously he would have avoided for fear of arousing suspicion. For Octogen, nothing is more wonderful than this—except for the 8 chapters and 71 articles worth of the Oasis security regulations that refer to him by name.

"Come now, I'm not all that dangerous. Professor, why don't you talk to Chelsea and get her to stop watching me?"
—Doll Discussion Recording

projections.name: Explosives Engineer
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Demolition is more than randomly blowing stuff up! I will show you how this art is done!"

projections.name: Explosives Engineer
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Demolition is more than randomly blowing stuff up! I will show you how this art is done!"

projections.name: Thunderous Blast
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Blow up all the limitations nature set for us and establish new rules on a blank canvas. That's what I'm supposed to do!"

skinList.name: Elegant Lesson
skinList.desc:
From the "Classical Repertoire" Series — presenting film legends of old with the latest in modern technology as a tribute to milestones in movie history.
"Manners and decorum are essential lessons for any gentleman, and proper conduct is what distinguishes one from the masses."

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"Pro... Professor? I... I was just checking your cupboard for dangerous items. Ahem... Yes! Safety preparations are very important."

skinList.name: Blazing Skyrocket
skinList.desc:
You are my final guideline, tethering my last desire, the last blossoming of fireworks in the night of my life.
"Come on, give me your hand—In exchange, I'll give you the most unforgettable night of your life!"

skinList.name: Stress Expander
skinList.desc: A Doll's first awakening is akin to a human's birth and is of great importance to them. Memories, replicated in Magrasea with Neural Projection—"Gah, finally out of that stuffy box... whew. Let me see, what're you looking to blow up?"
